data.name: ALOHA (LeRobot)
data.description: A low-cost, open-source bimanual teleoperation system for robotic data collection. Developed by Stanford and integrated into the LeRobot framework, it uses Dynamixel servos to enable high-quality demonstration data collection for imitation learning and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model training.

mechanical_interface.reason: 非机械耦合类实体（芯片/协议/模型/数据集/电气总线），无物理安装面

data.name: UMI (Universal Manipulation Interface)
data.description: A portable, low-cost handheld data collection interface that converts human manipulation into robot demonstrations. Uses SLAM and ArUco markers for precise 6-DoF pose tracking without requiring a robot, enabling in-the-wild demonstration collection for imitation learning.

mechanical_interface.reason: 非机械耦合类实体（芯片/协议/模型/数据集/电气总线），无物理安装面

data.name: GELLO
data.description: A general-purpose, low-cost teleoperation system that uses 3D-printed linkages matching robot kinematics with Dynamixel encoders for intuitive kinematically-similar bilateral control. Extremely affordable at around $300, it supports a wide range of robot arms.

mechanical_interface.reason: 非机械耦合类实体（芯片/协议/模型/数据集/电气总线），无物理安装面
